title: Revision-bound entity evidence
responsibility: Selects the exact revision evidence for an entity and records why before/after results may not be comparable.

inputs.name: explorerEvidence.scope
inputs.description: Identifies the requested commit, whether the page follows the current tip or stays at a selected commit, and that commit's first parent (null when it has none). The function reads a parent side only in commit mode when parent is non-null.

inputs.name: explorerEvidence.revisions
inputs.description: Carries the stored head revision and the first-parent revision while available; parent is null when none is stored or undefined while it is being read. A revision is used only when its commit exactly matches the requested commit.

inputs.name: explorerEvidence.unit
inputs.description: Identifies the entity by its Harness unit id, which the function uses to select unit coverage and captures. Only id is read from this argument.

outputs.name: explorerEvidence
outputs.description: Returns evidence for the exact requested commit and, for a selected commit with a first parent, its parent; an unavailable or mismatched revision is shown as a gap instead of substituting another revision. Captures, scenario and state coverage, initial-commit status, and reasons the sides are incomparable are retained; only a usable, non-inherited capture is marked current.

after.gap: No unit registry is stored at this revision.
